build_async_llm_engine: build an AsyncLLM engine instance using AsyncEngineArgs with a model name and eager mode flag
create_sampling_params_streaming: create SamplingParams with DELTA output kind for token-by-token streaming inference
run_stream_response: run the stream_response async function to stream tokens from AsyncLLM and display them as they arrive
run_async_llm_generate: run engine.generate with a prompt and SamplingParams to stream output tokens asynchronously
run_main_example: run the main async entry point to initialize the engine, stream multiple prompts, and shut down cleanly
